name: gumorose-platform
description: Gumorose Platform — D2C/B2B textile on-demand manufacturing in Ecuador (Riobamba plant). Monorepo: shared industrial engine + Node.js CMS API + web + mobile.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @gumorose/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @gumorose/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @gumorose/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @gumorose/mobile typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @gumorose/shared test && pnpm --filter @gumorose/api test && pnpm --filter @gumorose/mobile test
